item.title: Four arrested in Martin County after armed robbery of teen and police pursuit
item.description:
Four suspects were arrested in Martin County on Monday following an armed robbery of a teenager and a subsequent police pursuit, according to the Martin County Sheriff's Office. The arrests concluded a chase that ended with deputies taking all four individuals into custody.

item.title: Byron Donalds skips Florida GOP governor debate as rivals mention him 60 times
item.description: U.S. Rep. Byron Donalds, the Trump-backed frontrunner for Florida governor, dominated Thursday night's Republican debate without attending. Former House Speaker Paul Renner, Lt. Jay Collins, and businessman James Fishback mentioned Donalds by name at least 60 times during the two-hour event.

item.title: Peacock House Art Foundation transforms Fort Pierce into artistic destination
item.description: The Peacock House Art Foundation is transforming Fort Pierce into an artistic destination, putting the Peacock Arts District on the map. The nonprofit preserves the legacy of Jaxson and Mary Crain in the historic Crain Estate.

item.title: 40-year-old driver killed in head-on crash on State Road 710 in Martin County
item.description:
A 40-year-old man was killed early Sunday after a head-on crash on State Road 710 in Martin County, according to the Florida Highway Patrol. The crash happened around 2 a.m. near State Road 710, also known as Beeline Highway, and Southwest Silver Fox Lane.

item.description: The Peacock House Art Foundation is transforming Fort Pierce into an artistic destination, preserving the legacy of Jaxson and Mary Crain who once called the property home.

item.title: Port St. Lucie approves land transfer for new Florida Turnpike interchange at Midway Road
item.description: Port St. Lucie City Council approved the first reading of an ordinance to give 7 acres of land to the Florida Department of Transportation to assist with a partial interchange coming to Florida's Turnpike.

item.title: Hobe Sound community raises funds for man who lost fiance Misty Dawn White in deadly house fire
item.description: A Hobe Sound man is leaning on his community after losing his fiance in a deadly home fire earlier this week.

item.title: St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office Marine Unit rescues 2 after boat sinks in Intracoastal Waterway
item.description: Two boaters are safe after their vessel sank in the Intracoastal Waterway on Wednesday, thanks to a quick response from marine deputies and the life-saving decision to wear life jackets.

item.title: Stuart downtown dock closes today for $3 million renovation to nearly double slip capacity
item.description: Stuart's downtown public dock closes July 6 for a $3 million renovation projected to be complete by next Fourth of July. item.title: Serena Williams withdraws from Wimbledon doubles with sister Venus due to knee injury
item.description: Serena Williams pulled out of her doubles match with sister Venus at Wimbledon on Saturday, citing a right knee injury sustained during her singles return earlier in the week.

item.title: Argentina survives Cape Verde scare 3-2 in World Cup thriller
item.description: Defending World Cup champion Argentina beat Cape Verde 3-2 in extra time Friday, with Lionel Messi scoring his 20th career World Cup goal before the match went to the wire in South Florida.

item.title: Trump intervened with FIFA president before Balogun red card suspension lifted for World Cup match
item.description: President Donald Trump called FIFA president Gianni Infantino to ask for a review of the red card that suspended U.S. forward Folarin Balogun, according to a person familiar with the call.
